items.text: Slavery was considered moral in many historical societies. Were they:

options.A: Objectively wrong by a universal standard they violated
options.B: Wrong by a standard they should have recognized
options.C: Wrong by our standards, unclear by any universal standard
options.D: Not wrong by their standards, which were valid for their time
options.E: Only wrong by our current standards, which are no more valid than theirs

items.text: Culture A practices ritual sacrifice; Culture B finds this abhorrent. Regarding which is correct:

options.A: Culture B is objectively correct—some practices are universally wrong
options.B: Culture B is probably correct, though absolute certainty is hard
options.D: Both have internally valid reasons; neither is objectively right
options.E: Judging another culture's practices is ethnocentric arrogance
